# Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO)
> Private volcano tours in East Java, Indonesia - Bromo, Ijen, Tumpak Sewu.

- [Why Travel with Java Volcano Tour Operator (JVTO)](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/why-jvto): Why travelers choose JVTO: police-led safety, verifiable credentials, private-only tours, and documented history.
- [JVTO Police Integration & Safety Authority](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/verify-jvto/police-safety): The founder's active Tourist Police commission — assignment orders, rank, and independent press confirmation — and what police-standard discipline means...
- [Ijen Health Screening – Real Checks, Digital Proof](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/travel-guide/ijen-health-screening): The mandatory Ijen health screening: real checks at your hotel, a BSrE-signed digital certificate, checked at the crater access gate.
- [Ijen Rijik: The Monthly Closure Day at Kawah Ijen](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/travel-guide/rijik-monthly-closure): Why Kawah Ijen closes on the first Friday of every month (the Rijik conservation cleanup, since March 2019) and how...
- [Booking Information – How JVTO Private Tours Work](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/travel-guide/booking-information): How JVTO private tour booking works: website-only booking, payments, changes, and Lifetime Package Credit.
- [Traffic Police Escort for Tourist Groups in East Java](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/travel-guide/police-escort-for-groups): How JVTO coordinates an official traffic police escort for large tourist groups in East Java — a formal request process...
- [JVTO Policy Hub](https://javavolcano-touroperator.com/policy): Navigation hub for the JVTO policy documents: privacy, booking/payment/cancellation, and inclusions/exclusions.
